dwgfillet.tip: Click two lines on the sides to keep: both are trimmed or extended to the corner, with a tangent arc when the radius is above zero
dwgfillet.radius_tip: Radius of the arc in drawing units; 0 makes a sharp corner
dwgfillet.st.arm_first: Click the first line on the side to keep
dwgfillet.st.arm_second: Click the second line on the side to keep
dwgfillet.st.click_line: Click a single line of the drawing
dwgfillet.st.other_drawing: Both lines must belong to the same drawing: start again
dwgfillet.st.changed: The first line changed: start again
dwgfillet.st.parallel: The lines are parallel and never meet: no corner can be made
dwgfillet.st.no_side: The clicked side has no length from the corner
dwgfillet.st.too_big: The radius is too large for these lines: use a smaller radius
dwgfillet.st.radius_bad: The radius must be zero or positive
